schedule_exceptions_scope_chk.name: schedule_exceptions_scope_chk
schedule_exceptions_scope_chk.value:
("schedule_exceptions"."scope" = 'clinic' and "schedule_exceptions"."location_id" is null and "schedule_exceptions"."professional_id" is null)
        or ("schedule_exceptions"."scope" = 'location' and "schedule_exceptions"."location_id" is not null and "schedule_exceptions"."professional_id" is null)
        or ("schedule_exceptions"."scope" = 'professional' and "schedule_exceptions"."professional_id" is not null)

schedule_rules_valid_range_chk.name: schedule_rules_valid_range_chk
schedule_rules_valid_range_chk.value: "schedule_rules"."valid_from" is null or "schedule_rules"."valid_to" is null or "schedule_rules"."valid_from" <= "schedule_rules"."valid_to"
